_comment: A plain empty bucket, and the only reason it exists is to stop the shared copy being reached.
That copy asks for `"loader": "neoforge:fluid_container"`, which is not a model loader on this band
-- the composited bucket is requested as an ITEM MODEL by the file in assets/bpm/items instead.
This is reached only if that one is missing, in which case an empty bucket reads as 'something is
wrong with this item' rather than as a different fluid.
